bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(git -C "$ROOT" remote get-url origin | sed 's#^git@github.com:#https://github.com/#; s#\.git$##')" = "https://github.com/seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot"
TARGET=5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
PIN=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-screen-7336082
CANDIDATE=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6
ACTIVE="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')"
EXPECTED="$(docker image inspect "$PIN" --format '{{.Id}}')"
test "$ACTIVE" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo "LIVE_IMAGE_CHANGED" >&2; exit 34; }
COMPOSE="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}')"
test -f "$COMPOSE" || { echo "COMPOSE_MISSING" >&2; exit 35; }
git fetch --no-tags origin "$TARGET" >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
if [ -e "$WT" ]; then
  test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
  test -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)"
else
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/.worktrees"
  git worktree add --detach "$WT" "$TARGET" >/dev/null
fi
docker build -q -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t "$CANDIDATE" "$WT" >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$ACTIVE" || { echo "LIVE_CHANGED_DURING_BUILD" >&2; exit 34; }
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy config -q
OLD=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-search-colors-5a93de6
docker tag "$ACTIVE" "$OLD"
success=0
rollback(){
  if [ "$success" != 1 ]; then
    current="$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true)"
    candidateid="$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
    if [ "$current" = "$candidateid" ] || [ "$current" = "$ACTIVE" ]; then
      docker tag "$OLD" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
      docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
}
trap rollback EXIT
docker tag "$CANDIDATE" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -f "$COMPOSE" -p deploy up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 6
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect "$CANDIDATE" --format '{{.Id}}')"
success=1
trap - EXIT
echo "SEARCH_COLOR_LIVE_IMAGE=PASS"
